dedupe_keys.name: opendosm water supply statistics for malaysia production consumption by sector and access to treated water by state

description: OpenDOSM, the open data portal of the Department of Statistics Malaysia, publishes three water supply tables produced from the key performance indicators that licensed water operators report to the National Water Services Commission (SPAN): annual water consumption by state, split into domestic and non-domestic use (million litres per day, 2003 to 2022), annual water production by state, and the proportion of households with access to treated piped water by state and strata. Coverage is Malaysia's 16 states, with Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya subsumed under Selangor and Sarawak combining several operators. Each table is a free download as CSV or Parquet from storage.data.gov.my and through the data.gov.my open API, under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the data are as of 31 December 2022, the latest year is provisional, no next update date is given, and the tables are state totals without operator or network detail. Simulation uses: state water demand and production series for capacity planning of water supply. Related records: the WHO/UNICEF JMP household water and sanitation database (data-who-unicef-jmp-wash-database).
